Concrete subclass for FGCZ proteomics SummarizedExperiment outputs

Source: R/ExploreDatasetSE_Proteomics.R
ExploreDatasetSE_Proteomics.Rd

Reads from a prolfqua-derived SE. Top-level rowData(se) is sparse; feature metadata and per-contrast DE statistics live nested inside rowData(se)$constrast_<name> DataFrames (note the SUSHI typo is preserved). The first contrast is the source of truth for feature metadata. feature_id is built from protein_Id (+ site / peptide_Id to disambiguate), and the assay matrices' rownames are remapped via .fid_lookup since SE rownames do not match the built feature_ids.

Value

An R6 class generator; $new() returns an ExploreDatasetSE_Proteomics object.

Details

Inherits the accessor contract from ExploreDataset via ExploreDatasetSE; overrides .build_config() and .prep().

ExploreDataset -> ExploreDatasetSE -> ExploreDatasetSE_Proteomics

ExploreDatasetSE_Proteomics$clone()

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

Usage

ExploreDatasetSE_Proteomics$clone(deep = FALSE)

Arguments

deep

Whether to make a deep clone.

Examples

se <- readRDS(system.file("examples/proteomics/SummarizedExperiment.rds", package = "exploreDE"))
eds <- ExploreDatasetSE_Proteomics$new(se)
eds
#> <ExploreDatasetSE_Proteomics  (se)>
#>   data_type:        proteomics
#>   feature_id_kind:  protein
#>   organism:         NA
#>   ref_build:        NA
#>   samples x features: 6 x 1384
#>   factors (3):
#>     G_  (primary): A, B

#>     isotopeLabel: light
#>   contrasts (1): B_vs_A

#>   enrichment:       (none)
